answer_1.quote: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have gained significant popularity, demonstrating exceptional performance across various tasks, including image classification, image captioning, semantic segmentation, and visual question answering (VQA).
answer_1.outputs: image captions and answers to visual questions

answer_2.quote: We adhere to the official evaluation procedure designated for the VQA v2 dataset. It is crucial to acknowledge that the ground truth answers for each question in VQA v2 are not singular; each validation question possesses ten ground truth answers, which are utilized to compute the VQA scores.
